title: Reporting information: who says what about borders

sections.content: You know how to report statements with *según* + the source and with *decir que* from B1 Unit 13. In a border dispute, every side has its own source and its own story, so it matters to say who says what.

items.spanish: Según este principio, cada país conservaba los límites coloniales.
items.english: According to this principle, each country kept the colonial limits.

items.spanish: Según los historiadores, hubo muchas disputas.
items.english: According to historians, there were many disputes.

items.spanish: Los gobiernos decían que los documentos coloniales apoyaban sus derechos.
items.english: The governments said that the colonial documents supported their rights.

items.spanish: Los historiadores explican que muchos límites eran imprecisos.
items.english: Historians explain that many limits were unclear.

sections.content: *Según* is followed by a noun (*según los historiadores*) and not by *que*. After *decir* or *explicar* use *que* and a full clause.
